subject: Re: Deployment mode & EU data residency - follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lars Hansen <lars.hansen@nordbank.com>, Sofia Berg <sofia.berg@nordbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Deployment mode & EU data residency - follow-up

Hi Lars / Sofia - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Key requirements we heard
- EU-only data residency (no cross-border processing to US) for both at-rest and in-process model inference.
- Customer-managed keys (KMS) hosted in EU preferred.
- Network isolation / VPC peering and audit logs for regulatory review.
- Predictable latency to branches in Norway (target avg <60ms) and no APAC routing.

Options and tradeoffs (high level)
1) Hosted API (EU region):
   - We can provision a Hosted account pinned to our EU region. Data and inference are kept in-region; we can disable cross-region fallback for the account to meet residency requirements.
   - Fastest path to production (hours-days) but less network-level isolation than Dedicated/Private. Supports customer-managed KMS and audit logging.
2) Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity in EU):
   - Dedicated GPU pools in EU, VPC peering, customer KMS, stricter tenancy isolation and SLA-backed latency/throughput.
   - Good fit if you need predictable performance and stricter network controls. Typical lead time: 4-6 weeks for provisioning and testing.
3) Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem):
   - Private control plane with customer-managed networking (or fully on-prem package). Full isolation and no cross-region routing.
   - Longer lead time (8-12 weeks) and more upfront effort for install/networking; best for the strictest regulatory environments.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, residency-arch-diagram.png (attached).

Immediate next steps I propose
- Confirm whether NordBank needs a hard guarantee (contract clause) prohibiting any cross-border routing - we can include in contract if required.
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with Aditya to walk through KMS, peering options, and latency sizing (30-45m).
- Share procurement contact and PO/contract timeline so we can align on Dedicated/Private lead times.

If that all looks right I can schedule the tech deep-dive for next week and share the Dedicated playbook.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Residency guarantee: NordBank requires a contractual guarantee that data will not be processed or routed to non-EU infrastructure (including for failover). Is that something Redwood will put in the agreement?
2) KMS: We need the option to bring our own keys and have key material remain in our EU KMS (Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS in eu-west-1).
3) Network: VPC peering (or an equivalent private link) is preferred. Can you outline the networking options and any egress flow that could leave the region?
4) Timeline & cost: Rough ballpark for Dedicated vs Private (order of magnitude CAPEX/OPEX) so I can flag to procurement.

Also, latency: our branch users in Norway are very sensitive - can you include expected p95 latencies to Oslo if we host in eu-west-1 vs having Dedicated in a eu-central region?

We'll need the SOC2 and an architecture diagram for our security review - saw the attachments you sent, thank you. Please loop in Aditya for technical details.

Hi Lars / Sofia - Aditya from Solutions here. Wanted to add technical details against the items you called out and propose concrete next steps.

Residency & routing\- Hosted (EU region): we offer account-level residency that ensures data storage and inference occur in the EU region. For accounts that require hard residency we can disable automated cross-region fallback; this prevents requests from being routed to other regions even under capacity pressure. Note: third-party integrations (analytics, downstream connectors) may introduce cross-border considerations - we'll review those in the deep-dive.

KMS / keys\- We support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own) with keys stored in customer-owned EU KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure). We can integrate via standard KMS APIs and never store plaintext key material in our control plane. For Private on-prem we can integrate with on-prem HSMs.

Network options\- Hosted: HTTPS-based connections with TLS; can be combined with IP allowlists and private endpoint (where available) for restricted traffic.
\- Dedicated: VPC peering / PrivateLink + NAT controls; traffic stays over the peered connection - no egress to internet unless explicitly configured.
\- Private: full network isolation; you control routing and there is no option for Redwood to route traffic outside your network.

Latency notes\- eu-west-1 (Ireland) p95 to Oslo: typically 45-65ms depending on branch ISP. eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) is often slightly lower for mainland Norway (40-60ms). We can run a quick latency probe from candidate regions to your branch IPs during the technical deep-dive to pick the optimal region.

Provisioning timelines & rough cost signals\- Hosted (EU-enabled): immediate; minimal setup cost; usage-based billing.
\- Dedicated (EU reserved pool): provisioning + validation 4-6 weeks; monthly reserved pricing with lower per-token cost and dedicated throughput SLAs.
\- Private (VPC/on-prem appliance): 8-12 weeks; initial engineering & ops setup cost; higher upfront implementation cost but lowest cross-tenant risk.

Attachments: dedicated-deployment-playbook.pdf (playbook stub)

Recommended next steps\1) Schedule a 45m technical deep-dive this week - we'll run through KMS, peering, and latency probes. 2) If procurement wants ballpark numbers, we can share a non-binding estimate for Dedicated vs Private; if you want accurate pricing we'll scope expected QPS/TPU and provide a formal SOW. 3) For strict legal residency guarantees, we can add specific contract language - Marissa can coordinate the legal thread.

Happy to schedule the deep-dive - propose Tue 17 Feb 10:00 CET or Wed 18 Feb 09:00 CET.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
